_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shops" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "gstin" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "state_code" TEXT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "terms" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "users" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "pin_hash" TEXT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "devices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "invoice_series_prefix" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "locations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "op" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempt_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "brand" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "hsn" TEXT NULL, "gst_rate_bp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "base_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "price_unit_factor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "track_serial" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("track_serial" IN (0, 1)), "track_coil" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("track_coil" IN (0, 1)), "min_stock_base" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "item_units" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id), "unit_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "factor_to_base" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "item_variants" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id), "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "size" TEXT NULL, "rating" TEXT NULL, "colour" TEXT NULL, "barcode" TEXT NULL, "sku" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "item_prices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id), "variant_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES item_variants (id), "tier" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "item_costs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id), "variant_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES item_variants (id), "cost_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "effective_from" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "parties" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "gstin" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "state_code" TEXT NULL, "tier" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'retail', "credit_limit_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ledger_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "party_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES parties (id), "entry_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ref_type" TEXT NULL, "ref_id" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "ts" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "invoices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES devices (id), "series" TEXT NOT NULL, "number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "invoice_no_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "party_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES parties (id), "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "subtotal_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "discount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "tax_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "round_off_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "paid_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'posted', "shop_snapshot_json" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("device_id", "series", "number"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "invoice_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "invoice_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES invoices (id), "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id), "variant_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES item_variants (id), "unit_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "qty_entered" TEXT NOT NULL, "qty_base" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rate_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "price_unit_factor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "discount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "gst_rate_bp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "tax_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "line_total_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "coil_id" TEXT NULL, "serial" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "invoice_payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "invoice_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES invoices (id), "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ref" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sales_returns" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "invoice_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES invoices (id), "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sales_return_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "return_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sales_returns (id), "invoice_line_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES invoice_lines (id), "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id), "qty_base" INTEGER NOT NULL, "line_total_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchases" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "supplier_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES parties (id), "supplier_invoice_no" TEXT NOT NULL, "supplier_invoice_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "subtotal_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tax_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "photo_id" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'posted', PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("shop_id", "supplier_id", "supplier_invoice_no"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchase_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "purchase_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES purchases (id), "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id), "variant_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES item_variants (id), "unit_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "qty_entered" TEXT NOT NULL, "qty_base" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rate_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "price_unit_factor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "gst_rate_bp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "line_total_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id), "variant_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES item_variants (id), "location_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES locations (id), "qty_base" INTEGER NOT NULL, "movement_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_type" TEXT NULL, "ref_id" TEXT NULL, "ts" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "shop_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "before_json" TEXT NULL, "after_json" TEXT NULL, "ts" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
